--- # 2026 Global‑Local Subscription Strategy **Goal** – Transition from a single USD‑based plan to a *localized* mix of price tiers, payment rails and sharing options that: 1. Capture the true **purchasing power** of each growth market (Africa, South Asia, Latin America). 2. Align with local **payment habits** (mobile money, QR payments, installment plans). 3. Respect differing **family‑sharing norms** & attitudes towards recurring billing. 4. Preserve / improve the **consolidated unit economics** (ACOS, LTV‑CAC, churn) so that investors see a defensible, growing book of business in USD terms. --- ## 1. Market Snapshot (2026) | Region | Currency risk profile | Avg. per‑capita income (USD) | Preferred payment rails | Family‑sharing norm | Recurring‑billing sentiment | |--------|-----------------------|------------------------------|--------------------------|--------------------|-----------------------------| | **Sub‑Saharan Africa** | High volatility, large cash‑only base | $1 200 | Mobile money (M‑Pesa, MTN‑Mobile Money); QR (Safaricom Pay); cash‑in‑store | Strong “pay‑for‑everyone” culture – flat‑rate family plans common | Skeptical; preference for “pay‑month‑by‑month” or “no‑auto‑renew” | | **South Asia (India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nepal)** | Moderate volatility; growing digital depth | $2 800 | UPI QR, Airtel Money, Paytm; installment (BNPL) via Razorpay ‑ PayLater | “Household‑shared” plans with 3–5 seats common | Mixed – “no‑auto‑renew” push in low‑income; high‑income OK | | **Latin America (Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Argentina)** | Inflationary; strong dollarization | $3 500 | OXXO‑style cash‑in‑store, MercadoPago, Boleto; installment via card‑BNPL | Family bundle of 2–4 seats valued | Accepts auto‑renew, but “pause‑feature” desirable | *Sources – IMF 2024/2025 IMF‑CPI, World Bank PPP, Industry‑specific mobile‑payment reports.* --- ## 2. Pricing Framework ### 2.1 Local‑To‑Global Mapping | Local Market | Base (USD) | PPP Adjustment | Price Cap (USD) | Local‑currency Price (rounded) | |-------------|-----------|----------------|----------------|--------------------------------| | East Africa | $8 | ×1.2 | $10 | 140 Ksh (€1.2) | | South Asia | $10 | ×1.15 | $12 | 750 INR (€10) | | Latin America | $12 | ×1.1 | $14 | 60 MXN (€12) | *The “PPP Adjustment” factor accounts for local cost of living and typical consumer willingness to pay. The **Price Cap** protects us from losing market share if other providers lower prices.* ### 2.2 Tier Structure (per Month) | Region | Basic (€) | Standard (€) | Premium (€) | Family‑Share Bonus | |--------|----------|--------------|-------------|--------------------| | **East Africa** | 8 | 12 | 15 | ‑20 % per extra seat | | **South Asia** | 10 | 15 | 20 | ‑15 % per extra seat | | **Latin America** | 12 | 18 | 25 | ‑10 % per extra seat | - **Basic** – 1‑seat, No ad‑s, 50 h weekly content. - **Standard** – 1‑seat, ad‑free, 100 h, offline download. - **Premium** – 4‑seat, ad‑free, full library, 24‑hr streaming, priority releases. - **Family‑Share Bonus** – *Discounted per‑seat price* once the plan runs 3+ seats in a household, encouraging “share‑hubs”. --- ## 3. Payment & Billing Strategy | Region | Main Payment Rails | Payment Flexibility | Implementation Notes | |--------|--------------------|---------------------|----------------------| | **East Africa** | Mobile Money (M-Pesa, Airtel), QR, Cash‑in‑store | – Pay‑monthly
– “Rent‑to‑Own” bundles (3‑month plan that auto‑converts to subscription after 90 days) | Integrate directly with mobile‑money APIs. Use **auto‑pay** only on an opt‑in basis. | | **South Asia** | UPI QR, Paytm, Airtel, BNPL (Razorpay PayLater) | – Monthly
– Installment 3‑month or 6‑month “Pay‑Later” plan | Use UPI‑instant invoices; credit cards can auto‑renew. BNPL must be partnered with local BNPL providers. | | **Latin America** | OXXO cash, MercadoPago, Boleto, Card‑BNPL | – Monthly
– Boleto “90‑day” grace period
– Auto‑renewable | Emphasize **“Pause”** button: customers can pause 1‑month per quarter without losing account. | **Recurring‑Billing Opt‑In** - Auto‑Renew is **optional** in every market, but we enforce a 7‑day notice prior to renewal. - Provide *“Auto‑Renew → Auto‑Pause”* workflow: auto‑renew triggers a 7‑day email/SMS reminder; if no action, auto‑renew occurs. **Currency Conversion & Risk Mitigation** - Prices are quoted in local currency but billed in **USD** on a daily basis using a **dynamic FX rate** (e.g., 3‑hour spot rate). - Hedge 50 % of forecasted receivables with forward contracts and FX options. - Use a *multicurrency ledger* in the ERP; revenue recognized in USD per IFRS 15. **Data Privacy & Compliance** - All payment flows compliant with local regulations (e.g., GDPR‑like data laws, PCI‑DSS, local financial watchdogs). - Store payment tokens, not card data, per local and global standards. --- ## 4. Family‑Sharing & Household‑Bundle Design | Market | Typical Household Size | Legal Per‑Seat Limits | Bundle Size | Price Incentive | |--------|------------------------|-----------------------|-------------|-----------------| | **East Africa** | 4 – 7 | 4 seats max | 4‑seat | 20 % off per additional seat | | **South Asia** | 4 – 6 | 4 seats max | 4‑seat & 3‑seat | 15 % off per seat | | **Latin America** | 3 – 5 | 5 seats max | 5‑seat | 10 % off per seat | ### Implementation - **Family Accounts** share a single payment method; each profile can stream simultaneously (subject to bandwidth limits). - **Seat Lock‑In Policy**: one seat per device to mitigate account sharing outside the household. - **Family‑Referral Bonus**: 1 free month for inviting a new family plan member. --- ## 5. Consolidated Revenue & Unit Economics | Metric | Target (USD) | Regional Variations | |--------|--------------|---------------------| | **Revenue per User (RPU)** | $120/yr | Africa: $75; SA: $90; LATAM: $110 | | **Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)** | $35 | Africa: $30; SA: $40; LATAM: $45 | | **Churn Rate (ANNUAL)** | 10 % | Africa: 12 %; SA: 9 %; LATAM: 8 % | | **Lifetime Value (LTV)** | $360 | Africa: $225; SA: $270; LATAM: $330 | | **ROAS** | 12:1 | Africa: 8:1; SA: 10:1; LATAM: 13:1 | **Drivers** - **Cost‑of‑Service** (content licensing, tech ops) is largely globally scaled; only marketing & payment fees vary locally. - **Localized price elasticity testing** ensures that we capture the median‑price consumers can bear without driving churn. - **Early‑bird incentives** (e.g., first‑month at one‑third discount) boost LTV while limiting CAC. **Consolidation Rules** - **IFRS 15**: Recognize revenue over the subscription period; allocate marketing/transaction fees to cost of sale. - **Currency translation**: Use “average spot” conversion on the invoice date; apply hedges at the 30‑day level. - **Profit Attribution**: Segment profitability by region; feed into “regional operating profit” dashboards. --- ## 6. Risk & Mitigation | Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation | |------|------------|--------|------------| | **Currency Depreciation** | High | Medium | FX hedging; local‑currency pricing; price cap to protect margin | | **Regulatory Change (payment)** | Medium | High | Continuous monitoring; establish liaison teams; diversify payment partners | | **Family‑sharing Abuse** | Low | Medium | Seat‑locking; device whitelisting; DRM; data‑driven fraud detection | | **Payment‑rails Failure** | Low | High | Redundant payment providers; fallback to cash‑in‑store; 2‑step fallback process | | **Data Privacy Fines** | Medium | High | PCI‑DSS, ISO 27001 certification; encryption; dedicated privacy budget | | **Consumer‑budget Cuts** | Medium | Medium | Flexible subscription lengths (3‑month, 6‑month); “pause” feature | --- ## 7. Implementation Road‑Map (12 Months) | Quarter | Milestone | Owner | KPI | |---------|-----------|-------|-----| | **Q1** | Finalize local‑pricing matrix + PPP validation | Head of Pricing | Accuracy ± 3 % | | **Q2** | Secure payment‑gateway partnerships (mobile money, BNPL, QR) | Head of Finance | 5 local partners signed | | **Q3** | Roll‑out family‑sharing & pause features in 2 markets | Product Manager | 10 % family‑plan uptake | | **Q4** | Launch full localized subscription in 3 regions | Marketing Director | 25 % new subscriptions | | **Q5** | Consolidated revenue translation pilot | CFO | NPV ≥ $5 M | | **Q6** | Full global rollout & iterative A/B testing | Growth Lead | 15 % increase in RPU | **Key Dependencies**: - Legal review of payment agreement. - Integration of local‑currency ERP module. - Localization of billing UI in 3 languages (Swahili, Hindi, Spanish). - Data‑driven A/B testing harness. --- ## 8. Suggested Analytics & Reporting | Dashboard | Data Sources | Frequency | Action | |-----------|--------------|-----------|--------| | **Unit‑Economics** | CRM, ERP, Payment DB | Monthly | Adjust CAC or pricing thresholds | | **Churn Heat‑map** | User behavior analytics | Bi‑weekly | Target retention campaigns | | **FX Exposure** | Treasury, FX feeds | Daily | Hedge optimization | | **Family‑Share Utilization** | User profiles | Monthly | Refine seat‑pricing | | **Payment‑Rail Loss** | Payment gateways | Weekly | Identify high‑failure modes | --- ## 9. Quick‑Start Checklist 1. **Validate PPP**: Re‑run PPP adjustment with latest IMF data. 2. **Engage local regulators**: Confirm payment‑rail approvals, tax‑incentives. 3. **Secure funding for hedges**: Estimate 50 % of forecasted receivables; allocate treasury. 4. **Build “Price‑Matrix Service”**: SaaS that auto‑applies local PPP & tariff adjustments. 5. **Publish local‑currency pricing**: Ensure compliance with local disclosure laws. 6. **Set up “Family‑Opt‑in” workflow**: Email/SMS triggers + app‑UI. 7. **Initiate “Pause” pilot**: Test user response, adjust churn model. 8. **Report consolidated metrics**: Use CFO‑approved translation methodology. 9. **Start A/B tests**: 3‑month vs 12‑month price points, “pay‑later” vs. “auto‑pay”. --- ## 10. Bottom Line for Investors | Metric | Baseline (USD) | Post‑localization (USD) | Rationale | |--------|---------------|------------------------|-----------| | **ARPU** | $100 | $120 | PPP‑aligned prices capture higher willingness to pay | | **CAC** | $37 | $35 | Localized marketing + payment‑integration costs reduce churn and accelerate growth | | **Churn Rate** | 12 % | 10 % | New “pause” and family‑bundle features increase stickiness | | **LTV** | $300 | $360 | More months paid + higher ARPU | | **Unit Economic Margin** | 60 % | 68 % | Lower payment‑fee variance; FX hedging protects margins | **Projected Impact (Year 1 Post‑Launch)** - **Revenue growth**: +25 % YoY (driven by 2× new‑market ARR). - **EBITDA margin upgrade**: 68 % (vs. 60 % current baseline). - **Cash‑flow stability**: FX hedging + local‑currency pricing reduces volatility by 20 %. --- ### Final Takeaway Localized pricing—anchored in PPP, tied to regional payment habits, and wrapped around flexible family plans and a “pause‑friendly” subscription—allows the streaming service to **capture intrinsic market value** while preserving a clean, consolidated USD report for investors. It blends *price discipline* (strict caps) with *consumer psychology* (family incentives) and *financial prudence* (currency hedges), delivering defensible unit economics across Africa, South Asia and Latin America.
